result.summary: Found 3 issues, most notably two duplicate restaurant cards appearing side by side in the 'Fastest near you' section, plus some truncation and cutoff issues.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side by side in the 'Fastest near you' section with the same image, delivery time, and price, making the list look broken or duplicated.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate entry or distinguish the cards if they represent different locations, menus, or offers.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is partially clipped at the right edge and the restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu...' is truncated mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Improve horizontal carousel spacing and ensure text truncation uses a clean ellipsis; consider peeking at the next card to indicate scrollability.

issues.description: The restaurant card below the pizza image in 'Popular right now' is cut off at the bottom of the viewport with no visible name or details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content area so the last item is fully visible.
